name: ISI Mark Scheme
description: BIS product certification scheme under which manufacturers may be granted a licence to use the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) on products conforming to the applicable Indian Standard.

name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: BIS registration scheme for specified products, under which manufacturers are required to register products that conform to the applicable Indian Standard and comply with the applicable regulatory requirements.
standard_mark: BIS Standard Mark with Registration Number

name: Certificate of Conformity Scheme
description: BIS product certification scheme for grant of a Certificate of Conformity (CoC) for products conforming to the applicable Indian Standard or specified conformity requirements.
standard_mark: BIS Standard Mark / Certificate of Conformity

name: Certification Scheme
description: BIS conformity assessment certification scheme applicable to specified products under the BIS conformity assessment framework.
applicable_context: Product certification under specified regulatory requirements

name: BIS Hallmarking Scheme
description: BIS hallmarking framework for precious metal jewellery and artefacts, involving BIS registration of jewellers and hallmarking through BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres.
applicable_context: Hallmarking of gold and silver jewellery/artefacts for declared purity and fineness
